passive.name: Dispossession
passive.text: The wearer's base SPD increases by **12/14/16/18/20**. When dealing DMG, ignores **18/22.5/27/31.5/36%** of the target's DEF. After the wearer uses Ultimate, gains "Blazing Sun," which is removed at the start of the turn. While holding "Blazing Sun," increases the wearer's DMG dealt by **60/78/96/114/132%**.

passive.name: Defiant Till Death
passive.text: Increases the wearer's CRIT Rate by **18/21/24/27/30%**. When the wearer uses their Basic ATK, they will gain 1 stack of Dragon's Call, lasting for **2** turns. Each stack of Dragon's Call increases the wearer's ATK by **18/21/24/27/30%** and Energy Regeneration Rate by **6/7/8/9/10%**. Dragon's Call can be stacked up to **2** times.

weapons.name: On the Fall of an Aeon

passive.name: Moth to Flames
passive.text: When the wearer attacks, increases their ATK by **8/10/12/14/16%** in this battle. This effect can stack up to **4** time(s). After the wearer breaks an enemy's Weakness, increases DMG dealt by **12/15/18/21/24%**, lasting for **2** turn(s).

passive.name: Kinship
passive.text: Increases the wearer's ATK by **24/28/32/36/40%**. When the wearer defeats an enemy or is hit, immediately restores HP equal to **8/9/10/11/12%** of the wearer's ATK. At the same time, the wearer's DMG is increased by **24/28/32/36/40%** until the end of their next turn. This effect cannot stack and can only trigger 1 time per turn.

tracePriority: Jolt Anew (A6) > Star Veil (A2) > Aqua Reign (A4)

entries.name: Beneficent Lotus
entries.text: Uses a 2-hit attack and deals Imaginary DMG equal to **100%** of Dan Heng • Imbibitor Lunae's ATK to one designated enemy target.

entries.name: Transcendence
entries.text: Uses a 3-hit attack and deals Imaginary DMG equal to **260%** of Dan Heng • Imbibitor Lunae's ATK to one designated enemy target.

entries.name: Divine Spear
entries.text: Uses a 5-hit attack and deals Imaginary DMG equal to **380%** of Dan Heng • Imbibitor Lunae's ATK to one designated enemy target. From the fourth hit onward, simultaneously deals Imaginary DMG equal to **60%** of Dan Heng • Imbibitor Lunae's ATK to adjacent targets.

entries.name: Fulgurant Leap
entries.text: Uses a 7-hit attack and deals Imaginary DMG equal to **500%** of Dan Heng • Imbibitor Lunae's ATK to one designated enemy target. From the fourth hit onward, simultaneously deal Imaginary DMG equal to **180%** of Dan Heng • Imbibitor Lunae's ATK to adjacent targets.

entries.name: Dracore Libre
entries.text:
Enhances Basic ATK. Enhancements may be applied up to 3 times consecutively. Using this ability does not consume Skill Points and is not considered as using a Skill.
Enhanced once, Beneficent Lotus becomes Transcendence.
Enhanced twice, Beneficent Lotus becomes Divine Spear.
Enhanced thrice, Beneficent Lotus becomes Fulgurant Leap.
When using Divine Spear or Fulgurant Leap, starting from the fourth hit, 1 stack of Outroar is gained before every hit. Each stack of Outroar increases Dan Heng • Imbibitor Lunae's CRIT DMG by **12%**, for a max of **4** stacks. These stacks last until the end of his turn.

entries.name: Azure's Aqua Ablutes All
entries.text:
Uses a 3-hit attack and deals Imaginary DMG equal to **300%** of Dan Heng • Imbibitor Lunae's ATK to one designated enemy target. At the same time, deals Imaginary DMG equal to **140%** of Dan Heng • Imbibitor Lunae's ATK to adjacent targets. Then, obtains **2** "Squama Sacrosancta."
It's possible to hold up to **3** "Squama Sacrosancta," which can be used to offset Dan Heng • Imbibitor Lunae's consumption of skill points. Consuming "Squama Sacrosancta" is considered equivalent to consuming skill points.

entries.name: Righteous Heart
entries.text: After each hit dealt during an attack, Dan Heng • Imbibitor Lunae gains 1 stack of Righteous Heart, increasing his DMG by **10%**. This effect can stack up to **6** time(s), lasting until the end of his turn.

entries.name: Heaven-Quelling Prismadrakon
entries.text: After using his Technique, Dan Heng • Imbibitor Lunae enters the Leaping Dragon state for **20** seconds. While in the Leaping Dragon state, using his attack enables him to move forward rapidly for a set distance, attacking all enemies he touches and blocking all incoming attacks. After entering combat via attacking enemies in the Leaping Dragon state, Dan Heng • Imbibitor Lunae deals Imaginary DMG equal to **120%** of his ATK to all enemies, and gains **1** Squama Sacrosancta.

entries.name: Star Veil
entries.text: At the start of the battle, immediately regenerates **15** Energy.

entries.name: Aqua Reign
entries.text: Increases the chance to resist Crowd Control debuffs by **35%**.

entries.name: Jolt Anew
entries.text: When dealing DMG to enemy targets with Imaginary Weakness, CRIT DMG increases by **24%**.

entries.name: Tethered to Sky
entries.text: Increases the stackable Righteous Heart count by 4, and gains 1 extra stack of Righteous Heart for each hit during an attack.

entries.name: Imperium On Cloud Nine
entries.text: After using his Ultimate, Dan Heng • Imbibitor Lunae's action advances by 100% and gains 1 extra "Squama Sacrosancta."

entries.name: Clothed in Clouds
entries.text:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

entries.name: Zephyr's Bliss
entries.text: The buff effect granted by "Outroar" lasts until the end of this unit's next turn.

entries.name: Fall is the Pride
entries.text:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

entries.name: Reign, Returned
entries.text: After another ally character uses their Ultimate, the Imaginary RES PEN of Dan Heng • Imbibitor Lunae's next "Fulgurant Leap" attack increases by 20%. This effect can stack up to 3 time(s).
